profiling_contract.aggregation_required: Aggregate every CUDA Graph node in the NVTX range; no single kernel represents the production pipeline.

workload.checkpoint_semantics: deterministic synthetic prevalence labels restored before every target; not phases observed from one trajectory
workload.graph_semantics: seeded exact-simple undirected circulant built directly in CSR; not a uniform random-regular sample
workload.node_updates_per_second_semantics: N * effective internal tau-leaps divided by median target wall time; a normalized node-step rate, not realized state transitions, frontier edges, or unique nodes changed
workload.timing_scope: one synchronized Simulator.step() production call; excludes graph/model construction, checkpoint restoration, and warmup

warmup_policy.phase_order: finish priming calls, then start a fresh duration clock
warmup_policy.synchronization: before priming and after every target call
